Name: Whats left
Author: K1riko87
Description:
[size=4]距离完美通关，你还差些什么？
What’s Left 将分散的进度整理到一个游戏内面板中，让你更方便地查看目标、查找线索，安排接下来的农场生活。[/size]
[size=4]What’s Left 仅作为信息辅助工具：[b][color=#00ff00]不修改游戏机制、不降低完成条件，也不会自动完成目标或发放奖励。[/color][/b] 收集、探索、交友和挑战仍由你亲自完成；需要提示时打开面板，查看后便可继续自己的游戏节奏。 [/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]按分类查看进度[/b]：涵盖星之果实、烹饪、制造、钓鱼、出货、友谊、技能、怪物讨伐、传送塔、黄金时钟和金核桃，并提供博物馆收藏辅助页。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]区分已完成与未完成[/b]：剩余目标按获取方式整理，支持搜索和来源筛选。点击详情，可查看具体进度、已收录的获取提示与相关条件。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]关注想完成的挑战[/b]：在详情中点击“关注”，即可将目标加入第一页的“关注内容”，方便集中查看，也可以随时取消关注。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]按需查看提示[/b]：提供“减少剧透”选项，让你自行决定要了解多少线索。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]支持扩展内容显示[/b]：可查看 SVE、RSV 等扩展添加的相关目标，通过“显示扩展”开关控制列表显示。隐藏条目不会改变游戏实际的完美度要求。[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]融入游戏的面板风格[/b]：采用像素风格界面，支持鼠标、键盘和手柄操作，分别提供中文版与英文版。[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]打开方式：[color=#00ff00]键盘默认按 F7；手柄同时按下左右两个摇杆[/color][/b][color=#00ff00]。[/color]菜单内可使用鼠标滚轮与滚动条浏览，按 [b]Esc[/b] 或手柄 [b]B[/b] 返回。[/size]

[size=4]
[b]English Detailed Description[/b]
What’s left on your journey to perfection?
What’s Left brings your progress together in one in-game panel, helping you check your goals, find useful hints, and plan what to do next.[/size]
[size=4]What’s Left is an information companion. [color=#00ff00][b]It does not change game mechanics, lower completion requirements, complete goals automatically, or grant rewards.[/b] [/color]The collecting, exploring, friendships, and challenges remain yours. Open the panel when you need guidance, then return to playing at your own pace. [/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Browse progress by category:[/b] Track Stardrops, cooking, crafting, fishing, shipping, friendship, skills, monster goals, obelisks, the Gold Clock, and golden walnuts, with an additional museum collection page.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]See what’s done and what’s missing:[/b] Incomplete goals are organized by acquisition method. Search or filter by source, then open an entry’s details for progress, available hints, and relevant requirements.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Keep your chosen goals together:[/b] Select Watch in a goal’s details to add it to Watched Goals, the first page of the menu. Unwatch it whenever you like.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Choose how much to reveal:[/b] Use Reduce spoilers to keep sensitive hints hidden until you want to see them.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Browse expansion goals:[/b] View relevant additions from expansions such as SVE and RSV. Show expansions controls their visibility without changing the game’s actual perfection requirements.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Enjoy a familiar interface:[/b] A pixel-style panel with mouse, keyboard, and controller support. Separate Chinese and English editions are available.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to open:[/b] [color=#00ff00]Press [b]F7[/b] on your keyboard, or click [b]both controller sticks at the same time[/b].[/color] Use the mouse wheel or scrollbar to browse, and press [b]Esc[/b] or controller [b]B[/b] to go back.[/size]
